svg.title: Cortex Agent build roadmap — 5 phases from foundation to production
svg.desc: Flowchart showing 5 sequential build phases: Foundation, Tools & Semantic Layer, Agent Definition, Teams Integration, and Production Hardening, with key tasks inside each phase.

g.text: Prepare Snowflake data layer for agent consumption
Expose monitoring capabilities as agent-callable tools
Wire tools into a governed agent with instructions
Replace polling loop with agent-driven interaction
Governance, cost controls, evals before go-live

svg.text: semantic views (not YAML models) — only format MCP server supports
Teams + GitHub as external MCP connectors (OAuth required)
eval framework gates production — do not skip
